events.title: Israel's Slavery in Egypt
events.description: A new Pharaoh who did not know Joseph oppresses the Israelites and makes them slaves. He imposes hard forced labor on them.

events.title: Moses' Birth
events.description: Moses is born during Pharaoh's persecution. His mother places him in a basket of reeds on the Nile, and Pharaoh's daughter finds him and takes him as her son.

events.title: Moses Flees to Midian
events.description: Moses kills an Egyptian who is beating a Hebrew and must flee to Midian. There he marries Zipporah and lives as a shepherd for 40 years.

events.title: The Burning Bush
events.description: God speaks to Moses from a burning bush on Mount Horeb and calls him to lead Israel out of Egypt. God reveals His name: I am who I am.

events.title: Moses Returns to Egypt
events.description: Moses travels back to Egypt with his family. Aaron meets him, and they gather the elders of Israel and tell them about God's plan.

events.title: Moses and Aaron Before Pharaoh
events.description: Moses and Aaron go to Pharaoh and demand that he let God's people go. Pharaoh refuses and increases the workload for the Israelites.

events.title: The First Plagues
events.description: God sends the first six plagues upon Egypt: blood, frogs, gnats, flies, livestock disease, and boils. Pharaoh hardens his heart again and again.

events.title: The Last Plagues
events.description: God sends hail, locusts, and darkness over Egypt. Pharaoh negotiates with Moses but still refuses to let the people go.

events.title: The Passover Lamb is Instituted
events.description: God gives instructions for the Passover meal. Each family must slaughter a lamb and smear its blood on the doorposts so that the angel of death will pass over.

events.title: The Tenth Plague and the Exodus
events.description: All the firstborn in Egypt die. Pharaoh drives the Israelites out during the night. After 430 years, Israel leaves Egypt with great plunder.

events.title: The Cloud Pillar and the Fire Pillar
events.description: God leads Israel out of Egypt with a cloud pillar by day and a fire pillar by night through the wilderness.

events.title: Crossing the Red Sea
events.description: God parts the Red Sea, and Israel crosses on dry ground. Egypt's army drowns when the waters return.

events.title: Moses' Song of Victory
events.description: Moses and the Israelites sing a song of praise to the Lord for the victory at the Red Sea. Miriam leads the women in dancing with tambourines.

events.title: Bitter Water at Marah
events.description: The people arrive at Marah where the water is bitter. Moses throws a piece of wood into the water, and it becomes sweet. God gives them promises of health.

events.title: Manna and Quail
events.description: The people complain about hunger in the Desert of Sin. God provides manna from heaven each morning and quail in the evening.

events.title: Water from the Rock at Rephidim
events.description: The people are thirsty and complain to Moses at Rephidim. Moses strikes the rock at Horeb, and water flows out.

events.title: Victory over Amalek
events.description: Amalek attacks Israel at Rephidim. Joshua leads the battle while Moses holds his hands up, supported by Aaron and Hur. Israel wins.

events.title: Arrival at Sinai
events.description: Israel arrives in the wilderness of Sinai in the third month after the exodus. God calls Moses up the mountain and offers the people a covenant.

events.title: The Ten Commandments
events.description: God speaks the Ten Commandments directly to the people from Mount Sinai amid thunder, lightning, and an earthquake. The people tremble with fear.

events.title: Book of the Covenant
events.description: God gives Moses detailed laws about slaves, violence, property, social justice, and worship that expand on the Ten Commandments.

events.title: Ratification of the Covenant
events.description: Moses reads the Book of the Covenant to the people. He sprinkles the blood of the covenant on the altar and on the people. The elders go up the mountain and see the God of Israel.

events.title: The Golden Calf
events.description: While Moses is on the mountain for 40 days, the people make a golden calf and worship it. God threatens to destroy the people, but Moses intercedes.

events.title: Moses Breaks the Tablets and Receives New Ones
events.description: Moses breaks the tablets of the law in anger over the people's sin. He goes up the mountain again, and God gives new tablets. Moses' face shines when he comes down.

events.title: Instructions for the Tabernacle
events.description: God gives Moses detailed instructions for the tabernacle, the ark of the covenant, the altar, the priestly garments, and the order of worship on Mount Sinai.

events.title: The Tabernacle Is Built
events.description: The people give voluntary gifts in abundance. Bezalel and Oholiab lead the work of building the tabernacle and all its equipment according to God's instructions.

events.title: The Tabernacle is Erected
events.description: On the first day of the first month in the second year, Moses erects the tabernacle, sets up the ark of the covenant, and consecrates the sanctuary.

events.title: The Glory of God Fills the Tabernacle
events.description: The cloud covers the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord fills the tabernacle. God's presence leads the people further on their journey.
